workflows.legacy:
name: Deploy to Modal Legacy

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      docker_tag:
        description: 'Docker image tag to deploy'
        required: true
        type: string
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      docker_tag:
        description: 'Docker image tag to deploy'
        required: false
        type: string

env:
  MODAL_TOKEN_ID: ${{ secrets.MODAL_TOKEN_ID }}
  MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET: ${{ secrets.MODAL_TOKEN_SECRET }}
  DOCKER_REPO: docker.io/burntlabs/zk-email-prover
  DOCKER_TAG: ${{ inputs.docker_tag }}
  MODAL_APP_NAME: zk-gpu-prover
  MODAL_STORAGE_VOLUME: zk-prover-artifacts
  GPU_TYPE: "H100:2"
  SCALEDOWN_WINDOW: 900
  TIMEOUT: 60

jobs:
  deploy:
    name: Deploy to Modal Legacy
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: testnet

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install Modal
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install modal

      - name: Deploy to Modal
        run: |
          modal deploy modal_app.py

      - name: Deployment summary
        run: |
          echo "✅ Deployed to Modal Legacy"
          echo "App: ${{ env.MODAL_APP_NAME }}"
          echo "Image: ${{ env.DOCKER_REPO }}:${{ env.DOCKER_TAG }}"
